hero.title:
Your skin,
*well-kept.*
hero.sub: Bespoke skin treatments using Korean medical-grade skincare and advanced devices. Each service blends refined techniques with high-performance technology for visible results, deep relaxation, and a luxury experience.

philosophy.title:
Beauty rooted
*in calm.*
philosophy.lede:
We believe beauty flourishes from feeling comfortable and empowered in your own skin.

That starts with calm. Inflammation is eased, the barrier is supported — and only then is skin receptive enough for results that actually last.

triad.title: *Holistic*
triad.body: Barrier repair, hydration, long-term wellness — not quick fixes. Every visit builds toward skin that holds up on its own, backed by education that outlasts the treatment.

triad.title: *Personal*
triad.body: No one-size-fits-all. Every facial is tailored to your skin type and concerns, guided by a clear, consistent method — so results are never a guess.

triad.title: *Restorative*
triad.body: Designed to feel as good as it looks. Comfort, ambiance, and care aren't an afterthought — they're part of the treatment itself.

services.title: The menu.

items.name: Mei Glow Facial
items.description: Built for radiance. A double cleanse, custom light peel, and micro-current infusion work together to refine texture and lift dullness, finished with a sculpting lymphatic massage. This is the facial for skin that's healthy but tired — the result is polish, glow, and a visibly brighter complexion.

items.name: Mei Reset Facial
items.description: Designed for stressed, irritated, or reactive skin. RF lifting, plasma and high-frequency, and multi-modal circulation work to calm redness and rebuild the barrier. This is the longest, most restorative session — the goal is genuine repair.

items.name: Mei Cica Facial
items.description: Centred on Centella Asiatica (CICA), prized for its ability to heal and soothe. A CICA + PHA exfoliating mask clears buildup without disrupting moisture balance, followed by a custom ampoule delivered via High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound and a CICA B5 modeling mask to lock in hydration. No downtime — just visibly reduced redness and a calmer complexion.

services.footnote: All services are bespoke. We professionally assess, listen to your input and preferences, and make recommendations accordingly.

aboutMei.title: Meet Brianna
aboutMei.lede: Brianna is an esthetician and the founder of Mei Skin. Her education shapes how she reads skin concerns, listens to client needs, and creates a nurturing environment in the treatment room. She brings over five years of experience at Vancouver's top luxury spas, alongside in-house education with BABOR, Éminence Organic Skin Care, Knesko Skin, Dr.esthé, Éclat du teint, and Dermabell to her practice. Her curiosity about ingredients and formulation is insatiable — she's always studying what works, and what's next.
aboutMei.body: Outside the treatment room, Brianna practices yoga, and has interests in health and wellness, informing the calm, considered energy of Mei Skin.
aboutMei.pull_quote: Good skincare should be bespoke — your skin changes, and your skin is unique to you.

items.q: What should I expect on my first visit?
items.a: Your first visit begins with a cleanse, followed by a skin reading — a conversation to understand your skin's history, habits, and what it needs right now. From there, we build a treatment around you.

Every facial at Mei Skin is bespoke. We draw from a variety of techniques and technologies, including custom facial peel cocktails, microcurrent hydration infusion, lymphatic sculpting massage, RF eye/face lifting, layered masking, ultrasonic skin scrubber extractions, high-frequency with plasma, paired with professional-grade Korean formulations chosen for your skin that day. A 60-minute visit (The Mei Glow) covers the essentials; a 90-minute visit (The Mei Reset) gives us more time to go deeper.

items.q: How long are appointments, and how often should I come?
items.a: Sessions currently run either 60 to 90 minutes, depending on how much time you want to give your skin that day. We recommend every a treatment every 4-6 weeks to achieve and maintain results.

items.q: Do I need to do anything to prepare for my visit?
items.a: We recommend arriving without makeup if you can — every visit starts with a double cleanse, so it will come off either way, but skipping it beforehand means we can start reading your skin right away. And if you're wearing sunscreen when you walk in, even better — we love that. In the week leading up to your visit, please avoid retinol and exfoliating products, and please book at least month after a chemical peel, microneedling, or facial laser treatment.

items.q: What should I do after my visit?
items.a: You're welcome to cleanse as usual at the end of the day. The one habit we'll always encourage: wear sunscreen every day, rain or shine. Even on cloudy days, UV rays still reach your skin, so keeping that protection consistent is one of the best things you can do for your results.

Absolutely. We have retail products from Dermabell, Éclat du Teint, Dr. esthé, and more available to purchase on-site. We would be delighted to recommend products for your home care routine should you be interested.

privacy.title: Privacy *policy.*
privacy.intro:
Mei Skin, a sole proprietorship based in Vancouver, British Columbia ("Mei Skin," "we," "us," or "our"), operates this website. This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is collected, used, and disclosed when you visit this website.

In summary: this website collects a limited amount of personal information, does not sell personal information to any third party, and does not employ advertising trackers.

sections.heading: 1. Information Collection and Use
sections.body:
1.1 Information You Provide. The appointment request form on this website collects your name, email address, and, optionally, your phone number, treatment of interest, and preferred appointment times. Submissions are delivered directly to our studio email inbox. This information is not stored in a database and is not shared with any advertising or marketing service.

Please do not submit information regarding skin conditions, medications, or other health details through the form. This information is collected in person during your first visit.

Correspondence conducted by email or direct message is retained in order to respond to inquiries, process bookings, and maintain a record of skin history between visits.

1.2 Information Collected Automatically. The following technical information is collected automatically when you visit this website:

Pages visited and time spent on each page;
The referring website or search engine;
General geographic location, at the city or country level only; and
Browser and device type.

This information is reviewed in aggregate to evaluate website performance and is not used to create an individual profile of any visitor.

sections.heading: 2. Retention of Information
sections.body: Booking and correspondence records are retained for as long as you remain a client of Mei Skin, and for a reasonable period thereafter, including as required for tax or insurance purposes. You may request earlier deletion of your information as set out in Section 5 below.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies and Local Storage
sections.body:
This website does not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

A single item is stored in your browser to remember that a preview password has been entered, so that it is not requested on subsequent page visits. This item is stored locally on your device, is not transmitted to us, and is removed when browsing data is cleared.

sections.heading: 4. Third-Party Services
sections.body:
This website relies on the following third-party services:

Vercel, which hosts the website and provides cookie-free visitor analytics. Vercel's servers may be located outside of Canada, meaning your information may be processed in another jurisdiction while the website is loading.

Google Fonts, which serves the typefaces used on this website. As part of this service, your IP address is visible to Google.

No advertising pixels are used on this website, and no information regarding your visit is shared with advertisers.

sections.heading: 5. Children's Privacy
sections.body: This website is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from individuals under the age of 13. If you believe a child has submitted personal information to us, please contact us and it will be removed.

sections.heading: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: As a business operating in British Columbia, Mei Skin is governed by British Columbia's Personal Information Protection Act ("PIPA"). Under PIPA, you may request access to the personal information we hold about you, request that it be corrected, or request that it be deleted. You may also request to opt out of further email or message communications at any time.

sections.heading: 7. Security
sections.body:
Reasonable measures are taken to protect the personal information we hold, and information collection is limited to what is necessary for the operation of the business.

No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and absolute security cannot be guaranteed. In the event of a breach affecting your personal information, you and the relevant authority will be notified as required by law.

sections.heading: 8. Links to Other Websites
sections.body: This website may contain links to third-party websites, including Instagram and LinkedIn. Once you leave this website, the privacy policy of the third-party website applies, and Mei Skin is not responsible for its content or practices.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The current version will always be available on this page, together with the date of its most recent update. Material changes will be identified on the website.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: Questions regarding this Privacy Policy, or requests regarding personal information we hold, may be directed to: contact@meiskinstudio.co

terms.title: Terms & *conditions.*
terms.intro: These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern the use of this website and the services provided by Mei Skin ("Mei Skin," "we," "us," or "our"), a sole proprietorship based in Vancouver, British Columbia. By booking an appointment or using this website, you ("you" or "the client") agree to be bound by these Terms.

sections.heading: 1. Booking and Appointments
sections.body:
Appointments are requested by email or Instagram and confirmed directly by Mei Skin. A requested time is not held or guaranteed until confirmation has been provided.

1.1 Cancellations and Rescheduling. Clients are asked to provide at least 48 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Cancellations or rescheduling requests made within 48 hours of the appointment will be charged 50% of the price of the booked service. Cancellations or rescheduling requests made within 24 hours of the appointment will be charged 100% of the price of the booked service. As each appointment reserves a single treatment room, a late cancellation results in an unfilled appointment slot.

1.2 Late Arrival. We will make reasonable efforts to accommodate late arrivals; however, a late start may result in a shortened treatment in order to avoid delaying subsequent appointments.

1.3 No-Shows. A missed appointment without prior notice will be charged in full.

sections.heading: 2. Age Requirement
sections.body: Our services are intended for adults. Clients under the age of 18 must be accompanied by, and have treatment consented to by, a parent or legal guardian.

sections.heading: 3. Treatments and Results
sections.body:
The services offered by Mei Skin are esthetic skin treatments. They do not constitute medical care, and nothing communicated in the studio or on this website should be construed as a medical diagnosis or medical advice. Clients with concerns regarding their skin should consult a physician or dermatologist.

Prior to a first visit, clients are required to disclose:

Skin conditions, allergies, or recent adverse reactions;
Medications and active skincare ingredients in use, including retinoids, acids, and isotretinoin (Accutane);
Recent treatments, injectables, or cosmetic procedures; and
Pregnancy or breastfeeding status.

Certain treatments may not be appropriate, or may be contraindicated, under these circumstances. Mei Skin reserves the right to conduct a patch test, modify a treatment, or decline to provide a treatment where doing so is necessary for the client's safety. This determination is made at the sole discretion of Mei Skin and is considered part of the service provided.

Skin response varies between individuals and between visits. No specific outcome or result is guaranteed.

sections.heading: 4. Assumption of Risk
sections.body: As with any skin treatment, there exists a possibility of reaction, irritation, or an outcome that differs from what was anticipated, notwithstanding the exercise of reasonable care and adherence to provided guidance. By booking an appointment, the client acknowledges and accepts this risk as inherent to the treatment provided.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, liability for any claim arising from a treatment or from use of this website is limited to the amount paid for the service giving rise to the claim. Mei Skin is not responsible for indirect, incidental, or consequential loss, including loss of time or income. Nothing in this section limits any liability that cannot be limited by law, including liability for gross negligence, or any right that cannot be waived by agreement under British Columbia's Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act.

sections.heading: 6. Client Responsibility
sections.body: Clients are responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the health and skin information provided to Mei Skin, and for following any pre- or post-treatment guidance given. Clients with questions regarding the suitability of a treatment should raise them prior to booking.

sections.heading: 7. Photography
sections.body: Mei Skin may take before-and-after or in-studio photographs for treatment record-keeping purposes. Such photographs remain private and are not used publicly unless the client provides separate written consent for their use on the Mei Skin website or social media accounts.

sections.heading: 8. Pricing and Payment
sections.body:
Prices listed on the service menu are final; no additional charges are applied at the time of service.

Payment is due at the time of the appointment. Prices are subject to change; however, the price quoted at the time of booking will be honoured for that appointment.

sections.heading: 9. Gift Cards
sections.body: Gift cards are available with a minimum amount of $25.00 CAD and a maximum amount of $1000.00 CAD, and may be issued electronically. Gift cards do not expire, are non-refundable, and may not be redeemed for cash.

sections.heading: 10. Website Content

All text, photographs, and design elements on this website are the property of Mei Skin. Reproduction or use of this content without prior written permission is prohibited.

While reasonable efforts are made to keep the content of this website accurate and current, the website is provided on an "as is" basis, without warranty of any kind, express or implied.

sections.heading: 12. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of British Columbia and the federal laws of Canada applicable therein. Any dispute arising from these Terms or from services provided will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of British Columbia.
